findings: Header-only auth — impersonation of any wallet: The x-wallet-address header is trusted without cryptographic verification. Any HTTP client can forge any wallet address and write to profile, chatbot logs, audit logs, or read admin audit logs. Before public deployment, replace with a nonce-sign-verify scheme using ethers.verifyMessage() on the server.

Hardcoded AES passphrase: "Intellihealth-HIPAA-Key" is the default in crypto.js and pre-filled in DoctorDashboardPage.jsx. Any record encrypted with the default is decryptable by anyone reading the source. Derive a per-user key from MetaMask personal_sign output, or at minimum require doctors to supply a passphrase explicitly with no default.

AppointmentMeta model has no route: backend/models/AppointmentMeta.js exists and is well-formed, but server.js mounts only /api/profile, /api/chatbot, and /api/audit. There is no /api/appointment route file. Any frontend feature that stores appointment notes in MongoDB will silently get a 404. Either add the route or remove the model to avoid confusion.

wait-on file: path in dev script may block on Windows: The root package.json dev script uses wait-on file:frontend/src/contract.json. On Windows, wait-on's file: protocol resolves relative paths from the CWD at the time concurrently spawns the process. If CWD differs from the repo root the watch never resolves and the frontend process hangs silently. Change to an absolute path or switch to a tcp: check.
